correctness.rationale: With U,V independent uniform residues and W={U+V} mod 1, the pairs (U,V), (U,W), (V,W) are product-uniform. The three integer-line crossing counts equal integer displacements m,n,r plus respective Bernoulli indicators of U>1-alpha, V>1-beta and W>1-gamma where gamma={alpha+beta}; all are pairwise independent. Triple success probability is alpha beta for alpha+beta<=1, or gamma^2 for alpha+beta>=1, yielding centered triple interaction tau=alpha beta(1-alpha-beta) or -(alpha+beta-1)(1-alpha)(1-beta). All eight joint masses follow from independent product masses plus tau times the sign of the three-way (z_j-1) correction; scalar correction tau(z-1)^3 has coefficients (-tau,3tau,-3tau,tau). Thus TV=4|tau| for sum and full vector; AM-GM gives exact +/-1/27 at (1/3,1/3) and (2/3,2/3). Integer parts shift counts only; exact all-length statement follows from torus residues. Independently clipped rational polygons in the two-dimensional unit square for seven alpha,beta pairs including boundary and extremizers, checked all eight masses and moments; analytic torus argument is unrestricted.
